extraction.notes: Whole document read. The North Macedonia paragraphs (55 to 66, pages 23-25) contain no Chapter 2 or technology content. Three horizontal passages addressed to the Western Balkans or all partners are extracted (Digital Agenda, digital service delivery, cyber cooperation). Not extracted: 'digital policy' in a list of areas of EU engagement (paragraph 3, no claim about partners), the EU commitment to support partners' resilience in areas 'such as food and energy security and cyber threats' (paragraph 17: the EU's own assistance commitment with cyber threats as one example), 'promoting the crucial green and digital transitions' in budget policy (paragraph 18, incidental), the sentence 'The EU will continue deepen this cooperation and its support to partners' after item -0003 (EU commitment), and passages about other countries. Speaker recorded as 'Council' as printed. Second-pass check done (G3 condition 2), see review/RUN-2026-01/second_pass/.

items.stated_text: In this context, the Council is looking forward to the full implementation of the Economic and Investment Plan and the Green and Digital Agendas for the Western Balkans, both important tools for bridging the socio-economic gap, improving infrastructure and connectivity, and supporting the region’s green and digital transition while building resilience and energy independence.
items.summary: The Council looks forward to full implementation of the Economic and Investment Plan and the Green and Digital Agendas for the Western Balkans, supporting the digital transition.
